_note: M2 'apply learnings' phase. All text is draft for the director to rewrite. The director wants this phase to be practice, so it should guide lightly.

steps.title: A bigger park
steps.body: Beyond the wombats' corner, a small mob of western grey kangaroos is struggling. Find them and click one to see what they need.

steps.title: The mob
steps.body: Kangaroos graze on native grasses and need water within reach. A mob keeps watch together, so the more of them there are, the safer each one feels. Meet their needs and more kangaroos will join.

steps.title: Possums
steps.body: Brushtail possums den in tree hollows, but hollows take a century to form. Rangers put up nest boxes instead. Put a nest box close to eucalypts and possums will move in.

steps.title: Harmony
steps.body: Bring every species to contentment to pass the harmony gate. Open the checklist to see who still needs help.

finale.title: Harmony
finale.body: Every species in this part of the park is content. You've left it better than you found it.
